thread:
mike: Hey — running into 403 on the project console for a few teammates after our IdP upgrade. They were fine yesterday. Getting 'permission denied' when trying to open project settings. Anyone seen this?
anya: Ugh. Do they show up in the org roster as the same user? Any chance the IdP changed the email casing or stripped a +tag? :thinking_face:
mike: Checked. In the console the user email looks lowercase and the IdP was sending uppercase previously. Also noticed one account appears twice in SCIM as two objects (one with +devtag, one without).
sean: That usually means SCIM normalization created a second identity so the original role bindings are attached to the old principal. When the IdP normalized the attribute we end up with an orphaned role and a new member without roles -> 403.
talia: Can you paste the org_id and affected project id? We can do a resync and reattach roles manually for now.
mike: org: org-72a9, project: proj-88b2. Customer reports 3 users: "alex+dev@example.com" -> now appears as "alex@example.com". They accepted invites previously.
anya: Ok. Quick repro: invite user with +tag, accept invite. Rotate IdP so SCIM creates normalized entry -> login -> 403. We'll need to: 1) detect duplicate SCIM identities, 2) merge or remap role bindings.
sean: Workaround for support: run a one-off migration to copy role bindings from the orphaned principal to the normalized principal. I can run an internal job but need confirmation from security.
infra-bot: deploy-notice: Started a readonly dump of SCIM membership for org-72a9 at 2026-03-17T14:23Z
mike: If you can map bindings that would help. We told the customer not to change the IdP, but they already upgraded. They need console access now.
talia: @sean please include the affected member IDs. Also we should check token scopes on service accounts — sometimes admin tokens reference the old principal id.
sean: Got it. I ran a quick query: old_principal_id=usr_0a1b2c, new_principal_id=usr_9f8e7d. I will prepare a script to clone role attachments: 
```
# sample fix (internal only)
for binding in get_bindings(old_principal_id):
  create_binding(new_principal_id, binding.role, binding.resource)
  mark_as_migrated(binding.id)
```
mike: Thanks. Any risk of elevating privileges accidentally?
anya: Minimal if we scope to the explicit project bindings and skip org-level admin roles. We'll only copy project-level roles for now. Security approved via DM.
sean: Patch applied to org-72a9: copied 3 project bindings. alex@example.com can access project console again. 
infra-bot: audit: role-copy job completed for org-72a9 by sean at 2026-03-17T14:31Z.
mike: Verified with customer — console access restored. They want a permanent guardrail so this doesn't recur.
talia: Follow-ups: 1) Add detection for SCIM duplicate principals on resync, 2) Emit warning when user attribute change would orphan roles, 3) Offer a self-service 'merge identities' in the console (security review needed).
anya: I'll file a P0 issue for the detection and add to the SRE backlog for the merge flow.
sean: Adding a short-term mitigation: when SCIM updates an existing user and it results in a new internal id, keep a tombstone pointer from old id to new id for 7 days so bindings can be auto-migrated.
mike: Appreciated, thanks all :heart:
anya: tagging product + security in the ticket. cc @product-team @security
